title: Xe buýt miễn phí · Problems / Solutions
prompt: Some societies are considering making urban public transport free to use. What problems could this create, and what measures could be taken to address them?
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs: Abolishing urban transport fares changes both household travel budgets and the revenue available to run services. Removing fare revenue can undermine services just as demand rises; replacement operating budgets and additional capacity must come before universal free travel.

Free travel may divert funding from frequency and reliability, which often matter more than price. Fare income may fund vehicles, staffing and frequency. If authorities remove it without a replacement budget, rising demand can coincide with fewer usable services, leaving passengers with free access in principle but longer waits and overcrowding that prevent reliable journeys. A fare-free bus is of limited help to a jobseeker if infrequent or unreliable services make it impossible to arrive for an interview on time. Fare income may fund vehicles, staffing and frequency. A passenger who previously paid for a dependable bus may become worse off if the fare disappears but the timetable is cut to cover lost revenue. Crowding can also prevent boarding at intermediate stops, so nominally free travel may be least usable by people who cannot change when they travel.

Authorities should secure adequate operating capacity before removing all fares. Securing operating funds and capacity prevents a popular free service from becoming overcrowded or infrequent, which would erode the access benefit used to justify it. Authorities should budget for extra drivers and vehicles before fares disappear, using expected peak demand rather than current ridership alone to avoid replacing a money barrier with a capacity barrier. Authorities should estimate both additional ridership and the cost of maintaining regular departures, committing recurring operating funding rather than relying on a one-off grant that leaves later services vulnerable.
Overall, authorities should compare free fares with targeted concessions and service improvements, using reliable access to destinations rather than ticket price alone as the test.

paragraphs.quote: Authorities should secure adequate operating capacity before removing all fares. Securing operating funds and capacity prevents a popular free service from becoming overcrowded or infrequent, which would erode the access benefit used to justify it. Authorities should budget for extra drivers and vehicles before fares disappear, using expected peak demand rather than current ridership alone to avoid replacing a money barrier with a capacity barrier. Authorities should estimate both additional ridership and the cost of maintaining regular departures, committing recurring operating funding rather than relying on a one-off grant that leaves later services vulnerable.
paragraphs.why: Nếu tiền vé mất làm giảm tần suất, lợi ích giá bị triệt tiêu. Bảo đảm vận hành trước giữ lựa chọn thật; cần so miễn toàn bộ với giảm vé mục tiêu và tăng chuyến.
